sections.heading: Flagged items in detail
paragraphs: Debt-to-Equity Trajectory: Leverage moved from 2.55x to 1.31x equity. Leverage is high enough to transmit an earnings shock directly into equity value.
Current Ratio Liquidity: Current assets cover current liabilities 0.53 times. Liquidity is tight relative to short-term obligations.
Share Dilution Check: The share count changed +2.2% a year. Dilution transfers value from existing holders to new issuance.
CapEx Intensity Check: Capital expenditure averaged 46.3% of revenue. Capex intensity is unusual for the business model and needs a return check.
Earnings Volatility Check: Earnings per share fell in 1 of the last 4 years with a growth standard deviation of 64 points. Earnings are erratic, which argues for a wider margin of safety.

Auditor & Governance Cleanliness: Aggregating the accounting evidence: 3 hard red flags and 2 watch items, with a LojikX™ Consistency Score of 61/100. The pattern of flags warrants a closer read of the auditor notes and related-party disclosures.
